human_intervention.scope: scheduler diagnosis and configuration trust recovery only

time_and_intervention.telemetry_gap: Preparation, execution, evaluation, and archival were not measured as mutually exclusive actual durations; throughput economics cannot yet be calculated.

current_window.context_or_answer_leakage_check: #3494 stopped before solvers because evaluator/context isolation could not be demonstrated.

verified_experience_effect.conclusion: No posterior update is justified for Verified Experience versus no experience or ordinary memory. The window tested the operating system around validation, not the product effect.
verified_experience_effect.prior_historical_result_not_recounted: Earlier single-family work showed equal success, small command/token reductions and worse wall time; it remains non-generalizable and is not new evidence in this window.

model_strength_transfer_readiness.interpretation: Oracle readiness is not transfer evidence. With no independently originated target, treatment isolation, telemetry, or fresh contexts established, the correct result is zero suitable candidates and zero runs.

support: Six public commerce observations show that structured surfaces, auth/entitlement requirements, dynamic availability, and machine-fetch restrictions are useful context for describing where tasks stop.
DECLARED and OBSERVED labels prevented partner APIs, UI buttons, or public price strings from being misread as replayed transaction capability.
counterevidence: No paired replay tested whether these fields improve retrieval, route selection, success, latency, or human-intervention prediction.
Home Depot returned a direct-fetch 403 while indexed facts remained available, a counterexample to collapsing access into browser_only.
Partner/seller APIs at Best Buy and Walmart do not automatically imply consumer-agent access.
agent_accessibility_hypothesis.next_most_informative_test: On one separately authorized frozen public read-only task, compare routing/answer quality with and without the metadata while keeping sources and model fixed; score factual scope, abstention, tool choice, latency, and intervention.
agent_accessibility_hypothesis.schema_decision: Do not create a score or promote fields into required schema/ranking.

rsi_evidence_hypothesis.statement: In automated self-improvement loops, provenance-backed experience selection with counterexamples, degradation tracking, independent replay and revalidation may reduce false-positive experience accumulation relative to retaining successful trajectories alone.

evidence_tiers.provider_claims: No window evidence that proves recursive self-improvement.
evidence_tiers.third_party_measurements: LifeMem authors report cross-environment gains but also incompatible retrieval, negative backward transfer in some cells, token overhead, and over-clustering failures; this is adjacent memory evidence, not RSI proof.
evidence_tiers.reproducible_public_evidence: No independent AEG reproduction, longitudinal self-improvement loop, or public rollback/revalidation study was completed.

review_questions.inherited_artifact: LifeMem inherits distilled skills and selected trajectories; AEG window produced no new inherited Registry artifact.
review_questions.evaluator_identity: Paper benchmark evaluators are author-defined; AEG #3494 evaluator was isolated from solvers by stopping before execution.
review_questions.rejected_paths_retained: AEG preserves the falsified final-send path and blocked receipts; no comparative self-improvement loop used them.
review_questions.applicability_conditions: Proposed in AEG metadata, not validated by independent replay.
review_questions.negative_transfer_or_degradation: Reported in adjacent paper; not measured in this pilot.
review_questions.cross_environment_transfer: Author-reported adjacent evidence only; not AEG evidence.
review_questions.compounding_error_risk: Material and unresolved when successful trajectories are retained without counterexamples or freshness boundaries.

rsi_evidence_hypothesis.next_most_informative_test: Before any schema promotion, run a separately authorized longitudinal comparison in which success-only retention and provenance-plus-counterexample retention face the same repeated task stream, hidden holdouts, version drift, rollback triggers, and independent replay.
rsi_evidence_hypothesis.schema_decision: All concepts remain PROPOSED; no active ETP, ranking, budget, model, or schedule change.

bayesian_updates.counterevidence: Only about 21.5% of reviewed items qualified, and none reached verification.
bayesian_updates.next_most_informative_action: Stop adding supply and test conversion of the existing READY case.

bayesian_updates.hypothesis: The current pipeline can deliver 7-10 independently verified cases per week
bayesian_updates.support: One task remained objectively specified and READY.
bayesian_updates.counterevidence: 0 verified, 0 archived, 0 historical starts; READY stalled more than six days.
bayesian_updates.next_most_informative_action: Complete at most #3076 under valid budget admission and code isolation, then measure stage times.

bayesian_updates.hypothesis: Existing scheduler/consumer configuration converts READY work into completed evidence
bayesian_updates.support: Ten failures stopped closed; configuration trust preflight was recovered.

bayesian_updates.next_most_informative_action: One scheduled #3076 claim/result with read-back and actual stage telemetry before deadline.

bayesian_updates.hypothesis: Verified Experience improves independent-task correctness or efficiency versus no experience or ordinary memory
bayesian_updates.counterevidence: No valid pair, comparator, solver, command, token, cost, or latency observation.
bayesian_updates.next_most_informative_action: Do not infer efficacy from replay readiness; require a later isolated comparator study.

bayesian_updates.hypothesis: Explicit ownership/applicability boundaries reduce negative transfer
bayesian_updates.support: The protocol prevented an invalid self-evaluated pair.
bayesian_updates.counterevidence: #3494 did not observe a solver choosing to reject an inapplicable Experience and did not measure task outcome.
bayesian_updates.next_most_informative_action: Later test abstention on a clearly mismatched Experience in fresh contexts.

continue: Preserve strict objective-oracle and negative/inconclusive evidence standards.
Keep the existing repository, cash, case, and time scope fixed.
Use the remaining period only for the already READY #3076 replay if admission and isolation become auditable.
adjust: Treat READY-to-CLAIM and budget reconciliation as the binding bottleneck, not candidate discovery.
Record actual mutually exclusive preparation, execution, evaluation, and archival durations in future claims/results.
Count topics as search coverage, not verified mechanism families.
pause: Additional candidate expansion while one READY item is stalled and 15 qualified backlog items remain.
Any model-strength run, accessibility score, RSI schema promotion, or new transfer arm.
Any claim that #3494 demonstrates repair gain, transfer gain, or beneficial abstention.
falsified_or_rejected: The first-window 7-10 verified-case throughput expectation was not achieved.
Candidate scarcity was not the first-window bottleneck.
Operational readiness is not demonstrated by queue depth or protocol readiness.

highest_information_action_before_deadli.action: If and only if exact local budget admission and external-code isolation are demonstrable, allow the existing scheduled consumer to complete OSS-HIST-PYSDK-3076-REGEX-FULLMATCH revision 1 and produce a Registry candidate or explicit ARCHIVAL_BLOCKED result.

commands, tokens, cost and latency where observable
no counting as independent diagnosis or transfer
write/read-back of terminal receipt and candidate or ARCHIVAL_BLOCKED evidence
highest_information_action_before_deadli.otherwise: Stop without substituting more scans, reports, or speculative experiments.
